notes: Aero design with mineral-blue accents, refined light surfaces and neutral graphite dark mode.
Balanced glass on navigation, exercise selection and rest controls; solid content and readable logging fields.
Clear blue active sets, green completed sets and distinct personal-record, warning and error colors.
Consistent typography, spacing and controls across workouts, gains, library, schedule, settings and the updater.
Existing training logic, backups, Focus Mode, exercise identities, journal data and offline update behavior are preserved.
